Then, I thought I was free when I went to the debugger. NOPE! IT TURNS OUT THAT YOU ONLY HAVE 10 DEBUGGS BEFORE YOU GOTTA PAY FOR THAT TOO! “That’s how we make money”. So you’re gonna force people to pay a subscription to even use your app??? Second, why don’t you JUST MAKE THE PERSON PAY UP FRONT THEN GIVE US ALL OF THE FEATURES! I swear all of these “free” python apps are the same. They act like they let you code, then when you try to run it, it doesn’t even let you! Developer, please fix this problem asap to first, bring more people who genuinely want to code to this app, second to make sure no other bad reviews will be posted, and third, to make the app a WHOLE lot more usable.
